semantic_verdict.summary: The frame passes the exact 1080x1440 asset binding, visible near-closed lift gap, exactly two owned action hands, same-door participation, clear two-person separation, exact copy, one top-right brandmark, and no extra text. It fails the primary latch-mechanics gate: the lever spindle is 109 px, or 24.8 percent of the slab width, from the true right edge rather than the required 35-45 px. It also fails the return-path gate because the prints form parallel lift-side columns and a broad lower-floor loop, not two distinct non-overlapping three-print legs joined only by a tight U beside the lift.
